full_details: You woke by candle, with frost on the west panes, and the almanac had no play for today or tomorrow. You sat a long while at the desk and wrote Anne before the house was loud. Three nights were liked. The Queen laughed at Pope, once, aloud. The pay waits on an empty office. You gave her the sentence from Shottery brook, and the coffer as nine pounds more than at New Year. You did not give the total, and you did not ask anyone the price of a house. A paragraph went to each child, the same length, and none to your father and mother. You left the letter open on the desk. You joined the workmen to the queen who wakes. You did not number the leaves under that page. You opened the Chaucer at the Knight's Tale, where the cat had been, and the chronicle stayed shut. At dinner Mistress Ansell heard the feet and called it comedy. She asked if the queen is punished, and she held her verdict until there is an ending. Alse asked once, about the jaw, and did not ask again. After dinner you read a bill for Wise Man on a Bishopsgate post, and you walked home. You came home and sat with the morning's leaf while the light went, and you left the paper under her question blank. You looked at Gresham's plain tomb across the close, and you walked on. You missed supper. After dark you read the pages at Field's, a dozen leaves and no last act, and you stayed on after the reading until the leaf was shut. Field laughed, and he wiped his eyes. Jacqueline told you not to punish the queen. You told them you have not been paid. Field's chronicle stayed shut on the shelf. You brought the pages home in the same fold. The letter was still on the board when you slept. Gib was on the chronicle when you came in, and Alse put him on the Chaucer.
one_sentence: You wrote Anne, wrote the page of the workmen and the queen, read a bill for Wise Man, and stayed at Field's until the leaf was shut.
title: Wrote Anne, the workmen's page, and stayed at Field's
